detail: Full summary: The #42 dashboard single-instance guard composes well with shared stores: sibling repos pointing at one TWINING_PROJECT resolve the same projectRoot, so only the first session hosts the dashboard and the rest stay MCP-only — exactly the wanted behavior for the fleet use case.
